findings.text: SLICE-001 explicitly owns PRD-AC-032, but the candidate has no legitimate window-lifecycle publication path and TS-TEST-013 never exercises one. UiSystem:AddWindowAsync/AddWindowTypedAsync return UnknownWindowId, BaseWindowView Open/Close are no-ops, and the test only publishes pointer/button/TextBox/form actions plus a derived game.* action (src/ReplicatedStorage/Client/UI/UiSystem.luau:121, src/ReplicatedStorage/Client/UI/Windows/BaseWindowView.luau:31, src/ServerScriptService/Tests/UiSystemTestRunner.luau:316). Consequently a root subscriber cannot currently receive both a user action and a window lifecycle event from the shared catalog as PRD-AC-032 requires; merely listing ui.window.* constants does not satisfy the observable acceptance criterion.
